name: KPJ Healthcare Berhad
summary: KPJ Healthcare Berhad, an investment holding company, engages in the operation of specialist hospitals in Malaysia, Thailand, and Australia. It provides pathology and laboratory services; management and engineering maintenance services for specialist hospitals; and medical and consultancy services for eye care, as well as maintenance services for medical equipment.
